intro: This errand serves as a vital step in formalizing an arrangement between the informant Andron Gant and the Deathstalkers of the Undercity. After securing his cooperation, an operative delivers Gant's comprehensive ledger directly into the hands of Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter. The exchange marks the transition from simple inquiries to deeper, more covert operations on behalf of the Forsaken state.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You'll find the ledger with the information your employers seek on the bookshelf behind me. Deliver it with my regards, and tell them that I would prefer it if they sent you, if they find enough value that they should wish to continue our arrangement.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well, this is certainly more information than I suspected to get out of Andron. Give me a moment to peruse it, before I set you to your next task.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
